user.title: HA Custom Amber Electric Integration
user.description: Not the official Amber Electric integration. This custom integration controls battery overrides via the Smart Shift API. Sign in with your Amber Electric app credentials — your site and battery are detected automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your Amber password has changed or the login expired. Enter your password again.

power_sensors.title: Power sensors (optional)
power_sensors.description: Point the dashboard's Power card at your own battery, solar, load and grid sensors. Every field here is optional - leave any (or all) of them blank and skip this entirely if you'd rather. You can always set these later, one at a time, under the integration's Configuration section - nothing here is final.

data.power_battery_level_sensor: Battery level sensor (optional - defaults to Amber's own reading if left blank)

init.title: HA Custom Amber Electric Integration options
init.description: Two independent poll intervals. Prices only update every 5 minutes on Amber's side regardless of the Market Price interval, so there's nothing to gain from setting it lower than that. Statistics (battery SOC, battery power, override status) are closer to real-time, which is what the faster Statistics interval is for.
